paper_pointed_threat.subsumption_argument: ToPi（supplemental_primary，§4.2–4.3；https://arxiv.org/html/2602.01609v1）在冻结 diffusion transformer 上按 target-to-context 的 attention/value contribution 排序，保留累计贡献达到 τ 的最小 context 子集，在 anchor denoising steps 重评分并在其间复用、压紧该子集；这已覆盖本候选“读出贡献分数→累计阈值选 context→跨 solver steps 复用”的通用 recipe。ToPi 的对象是图像编辑中的 target latents 与 reference tokens，并未检验 WAM action-query→observation-source edges、机器人 task success 或这一 action 路径的完整时延，故它不是同一 WAM 机制的 exact overlap。CAPA（supplemental_primary，§4.1 Eq.(2)；https://arxiv.org/html/2602.00247v1）另已使用经 W_O 投影、取 residual contribution norm 的视觉 token 分数，因此投影本身也不能支撑新颖性；当前候选仍可主张 WAM-specific 边选择，但必须在相同保留边数和任务结果下显示其分数优于这些先前分数。
paper_pointed_threat.addressable_via: 在 falsification_prediction 中增加等保留 action-query→observation 边数的 raw attention-mass 与 ToPi/VATP/CAPA-style contribution 评分对照臂。

falsification_structure_check.reasoning: 候选明确比较 dense、rho_lg-ranked 与等保留边成本的 source-group permutation，在配对 frozen-WAM episodes 上以 LIBERO/RoboLab task success 的方向和原冻结 gate 作判断，并完整计入 scoring、packing、kernel 与模型路径时延；rho_lg 是明示的单一负载量，置换控制针对下游 task outcome。按 T5 regime note 的限制，取三个等 token 数的 source groups、r=[3,2,1]、epsilon=1/3，保留 AB（5/6≥2/3）后置换可得等成本的 BC 控制；因此不把不等组大小这一条件性情形当结构阻塞。T3 的相同 value 输出是参数依赖备注，blocking file 也显示另一合法赋值会改变输出。

verdict_rationale: ToPi 的累计贡献选集与跨 denoising-step 复用、以及 CAPA 已有的 W_O-projected contribution，使通用 scoring/pruning recipe 和投影分数本身不能作为新颖性依据；但两者都未验证 WAM action-only observation edges 的任务因果效应，故没有 exact-overlap hard-floor。falsification_structure_check 为 sound 且 blocking_findings 中没有 B 项；由于当前 group-permutation 只检验排名敏感性，不能证明候选分数胜过 attention mass 或先前 contribution score，按 paper_pointed_threat.addressable_via 授权一项 strengthen-only 对照扩充。

revision_targets.issue: paper_pointed_threat：ToPi 已覆盖累计贡献选集与迭代生成中的 subset reuse，CAPA 已使用 output-projected contribution；当前仅比较候选 rho_lg 与置换排名，未检验其相对这些评分法或 raw action-attention mass 的 WAM task-outcome 增量。
revision_targets.fix_direction: 只新增相同 frozen WAM、相同 k_ref、相同 action-query→observation 保留边数及同一 compact kernel 下的评分基线：native attention-mass group ranking、ToPi/VATP attention×value-norm 聚合到 source groups、以及 CAPA per-token W_O-projected contribution 聚合到 source groups。保留现有 dense、rho_lg-ranked、group-permutation arms、task-success metric、完整路径 latency accounting 与原 claim 不变；该配对判断用于检验候选 score 是否带来 WAM-specific task-action 增量。

threat_grounding.title: Token Pruning for In-Context Generation in Diffusion Transformers
threat_grounding.grounding: §4.2–4.3 defines context-token contribution from attention-weighted value norms, selects the smallest subset meeting a cumulative contribution fraction, updates it at anchor diffusion steps, and reuses/prunes the subset between anchors.
threat_grounding.scope_boundary: Training-free image-editing DiTs; no WAM action-query edges or robot task outcome.

other_primary_neighbors.title: CAPA: Contribution-Aware Pruning and FFN Approximation for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models
other_primary_neighbors.grounding: §4.1 Eq.(2) computes attention-weighted values through per-head W_V and W_O projections, sums the residual-stream contribution, and ranks visual KV tokens; it establishes that output-projected contribution scoring itself is prior art.
other_primary_neighbors.scope_boundary: LVLM visual-token pruning, not iterative WAM control or action-query-only edge deletion.

other_primary_neighbors.title: Attention Score is not All You Need for Token Importance Indicator in KV Cache Reduction: Value Also Matters
other_primary_neighbors.grounding: VATP combines attention scores with the L1 norm of value vectors for LLM KV-cache token importance.
other_primary_neighbors.scope_boundary: Language-model KV-cache pruning; no WAM or robot outcome.

other_primary_neighbors.title: Contribution Weights: A Geometrical Analysis of Self-Attention Transformers
other_primary_neighbors.grounding: ICML 2026 proposes a projection-based token influence metric accounting for attention weight, value magnitude, and directional alignment with layer output.
other_primary_neighbors.scope_boundary: Transformer interpretation/importance analysis, not WAM pruning.

other_primary_neighbors.title: Attention is Not Only a Weight: Analyzing Transformers with Vector Norms
other_primary_neighbors.grounding: EMNLP 2020 analyzes attention together with transformed-input vector norms; the general idea that attention alone misses value magnitude predates the recent retrieval window.
other_primary_neighbors.scope_boundary: BERT and machine-translation analysis, not token-pruning or WAM control.

collision_neighbor.title: Bridging the Semantic-Action Gap in Visual Token Pruning for Efficient VLA Inference
collision_neighbor.grounding: VLA-Pruner combines semantic-prefill scores with temporally smoothed action-to-vision attention, then filters visual tokens under a compute budget; it reports manipulation benchmarks and a real-robot evaluation.
collision_neighbor.scope_boundary: Autoregressive VLA prefill/action decoding, not joint flow-denoised WAM or output-projected source-group edge masking; latency figures are not directly comparable.

execution_and_claim_boundaries: The candidate's rho_lg is a model-internal ranking proxy, not a causal gradient or guarantee of task-action sensitivity; only the paired task outcomes can establish an empirical effect for the tested frozen checkpoints.

Prior speedups use different architectures and workloads; judge candidate latency only from its full measured path, including scoring, packing, kernel launch, and untouched model components, alongside action-query→observation QK/AV FLOPs and Amdahl headroom.
The incremental mask remains training-free; any post-training already used to produce a baseline checkpoint is separate baseline cost. This review ran no GPU, cluster, or physical-robot experiment.

blocking_findings.findings is empty. T5 is a conditional unequal-group-size regime note; the equal-size camera/view assignment above makes a legal matched-cost permutation possible. T3 is a parameter note, not a universal failure.
